note: This is the system itself, so it gets audited like an app. site/ is the built docs site and test/ holds the audit's own bad examples. src/components and registry/ still count: their literals are the defaults apps get.

gradient-text.note: ob-gradient-text is the gold text I asked for on the portfolio. It breaks the written rule against gradient text.

font-loading.note: The docs site shows every theme, so web/fonts/fonts.css declares every theme's faces, served from the site.

mono.note: The Faces section says there's no monospace. That's the word in a sentence.

colour.note: The effects palette in registry/obvious/effects.css is the key card's hologram, the same blue-violet in every theme like the golds, so it's 9 fixed colours on :root.

font.note: Each @font-face in web/fonts/fonts.css has to name its family, so each one counts as a font stack. The pages use the faces through the theme tokens.
